The final disbursement is done in an annual basis  approved by another board meeting but the funds are already allocated to  the project based on the approved investment plan.  This was confirmed by  the  audit  team  through  the  cash  flow  analysis  done  in  September  2015,  where the total investment of the Fund for the project was estimated to be  around 3,9 Mio Euros, and in year 1-3 more than 30% of the investment had  already been made. During breakeven, more than 80% is already invested.  The fund assumes for the financials that the carbon credits generated have  a market price, but they use them for compensating for their own emissions  as part of their voluntary commitments. This commitment can be mobilized  annually,  so  it  is  secured  funding  that  is  readily  available  to  the  project,  therefore  being  in  compliance  with  Section  2.2.2  (5)  of  the  AFOLU  Non- Permanence Risk Tool.
